title: deskpress pack manifest
description: pack.yaml: what this app is called and where its parts are. Values may be in any language; keys are canonical English.

id.description: Stable slug. Calendar event ids derive from it, so changing it orphans every synced event.

name.description: What the app calls itself once this pack is loaded.

language.description: BCP 47. Picks the shell's own labels.

timezone.description: IANA name. The moment is computed in this zone.

content.description: One content file, several merged in order, or a map from root key to the file that holds it. The map roots each file under the key that names it, which is the only form where two files cannot collide.

theme.description: Theme file. Without it the shell uses its default theme.

files.description: Base directory for every file reference in the content.

version.description: The author's own version marker. The shell only displays it.

alert_prefixes.description: Unknown keys starting with one of these render as an Alert instead of a Card.

hidden_prefixes.description: Unknown keys starting with one of these never reach a screen: provenance, notes to yourself.

keymap.description: Canonical key -> the name this pack uses for it, grouped by where that key appears. Applied once, in the loader, so nothing downstream knows a pack might be in another language. Under root, a value may be a dotted path: days: itinerario.dias.

values.description: The two enums are structure, not prose, so a pack that writes them in its own language declares them here.

ui.description: Overrides for the shell's own labels. Anything not listed falls back to pack.language.
